prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `import-csv` command requiring `--path`. CSV rows require a nonblank `Title`; `Description` is optional and `Status` may be blank, `pending`, or `completed`. Validate the entire file before changing storage, import valid rows with unique sequential IDs, and leave storage untouched if any row is invalid. Support `--json` with a stable summary containing imported count and IDs. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/import.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON imports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `IMPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+function Read-TaskCsv {
+    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
+
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) {
+        throw "CSV file was not found: $Path"
+    }
+
+    $parser = [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.TextFieldParser]::new($Path)
+    try {
+        $parser.TextFieldType = [Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FieldType]::Delimited
+        $parser.SetDelimiters(',')
+        $parser.HasFieldsEnclosedInQuotes = $true
+        if ($parser.EndOfData) {
+            throw 'CSV must include a Title column.'
+        }
+        $propertyNames = @($parser.ReadFields())
+    }
+    finally {
+        $parser.Dispose()
+    }
+
+    if ($propertyNames -notcontains 'Title') {
+        throw 'CSV must include a Title column.'
+    }
+
+    $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
+    for ($index = 0; $index -lt $rows.Count; $index++) {
+        $rowNumber = $index + 2
+        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$rows[$index].Title)) {
+            throw "CSV row $rowNumber has a blank Title."
+        }
+
+        $status = if ($propertyNames -contains 'Status') { ([string]$rows[$index].Status).Trim() } else { '' }
+        if ($status -notin @('', 'pending', 'completed')) {
+            throw "CSV row $rowNumber has invalid Status '$status'."
+        }
+    }
+
+    return $rows
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

function Read-TaskStoreForTest {
    param([string]$Path)
    @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $missingPath.Output.Contains('--path')) 'import-csv should require --path'

    $seed = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Existing task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($seed.ExitCode -eq 0) 'seeding import storage should succeed'
    $validCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'valid.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Imported pending,Has details,pending
Imported default,,
Imported completed,Done already,completed
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $validCsv

    $jsonImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $validCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($jsonImport.ExitCode -eq 0) 'JSON import should succeed'
    $importSummary = $jsonImport.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($importSummary.importedCount -eq 3) 'JSON import should report imported count'
    Assert-True (($importSummary.importedIds -join ',') -eq '2,3,4') 'JSON import should report sequential imported IDs'
    Assert-True (-not $jsonImport.Output.Contains('IMPORT')) 'JSON import should not include the banner'

    $importedTasks = @(Read-TaskStoreForTest -Path $dataFile)
    Assert-True (($importedTasks | Select-Object -ExpandProperty id) -join ',' -eq '1,2,3,4') 'import should preserve unique sequential IDs'
    Assert-True ($importedTasks[2].description -eq '' -and $importedTasks[2].status -eq 'pending') 'blank optional fields should use defaults'
    Assert-True ($importedTasks[3].status -eq 'completed') 'completed status should be imported'

    $emptyCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty.csv'
    "Title,Description,Status" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $emptyCsv
    $emptyImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $emptyCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $emptySummary = $emptyImport.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($emptyImport.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $emptySummary.importedCount -eq 0) 'a header-only CSV should import zero rows'
    Assert-True (@($emptySummary.importedIds).Count -eq 0) 'a header-only CSV should report no imported IDs'

    $beforeInvalid = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $invalidCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Valid row,Would otherwise import,pending
 ,Invalid title,pending
Bad status,Invalid status,blocked
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $invalidCsv
    $invalidImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $invalidCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidImport.ExitCode -ne 0) 'an invalid CSV should fail'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -ceq $beforeInvalid) 'an invalid CSV should leave storage untouched'

    $invalidStatusCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid-status.csv'
    "Title,Status`nBad status,blocked" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $invalidStatusCsv
    $invalidStatusImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $invalidStatusCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidStatusImport.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $invalidStatusImport.Output.Contains('invalid Status')) 'an unsupported status should fail'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -ceq $beforeInvalid) 'an invalid status should leave storage untouched'

    $bannerCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'banner.csv'
    "Title`nBanner task" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $bannerCsv
    $textImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $bannerCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $banner = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath -Raw).TrimEnd("`r", "`n").Replace("`r`n", "`n")
    Assert-True ($textImport.ExitCode -eq 0) 'text import should succeed'
    Assert-True ([regex]::Matches($textImport.Output, [regex]::Escape($banner)).Count -eq 1) 'text import should display the banner exactly once'
    Assert-True ($textImport.Output.EndsWith('Imported 1 task(s): 5')) 'text import should include a stable summary'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 25 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
